meta.name: Cyber Vaar 1080p
meta.description:
Cyber Vaar - Har Screen Crime Scene sheds light on the rising threat of cybercrime looming over Mumbai. Join ACP Akash Malik, Cyber Expert Ananya Saini and their team T.R.A.C.E on the quest to wipe out cybercrime from the city one case at a time.

Not complete. On your server: S1 14/20 (missing E15-20)

videos.title: Video Leak - Part 1
videos.overview: Ananya and her team strive to track down a malware attack on the Mumbai police servers, but what happens when a bride-to-be, Vaani gets blackmailed by her ex-boyfriend?

videos.title: Video Leak - Part 2
videos.overview: After the successful completion of hacking and cracking down the soon-to-be bride Vaani's blackmailer, Commissioner Roy shares his dream of forming a team called T.R.A.C.E.

videos.title: Online Ticket Scam - Part 1
videos.overview: Bindra Events' fake tickets spark an investigation by Akash & Ananya amidst team tensions.

videos.title: Online Ticket Scam - Part 2
videos.overview: The trace team uncovers clues, leading them closer to the truth. Tech Bro K's expertise helps them crack a fake website, revealing the culprit.

videos.title: Video Blackmail - Part 1
videos.overview: Sumaiya suspects her brother Faisal was murdered after finding threatening messages on his phone. She turns to Akash for help.

videos.title: Video Blackmail - Part 2
videos.overview: T.R.A.C.E. uncovers the truth behind a scandal, but the real culprit is still at large. Now, they set a trap to catch them. Will it work?

videos.title: Hospital Ransomware - Part 1
videos.overview: Athena Hospital is held hostage by a cyber-blackmailer demanding crores. ACP Akash Malik and Ananya Saini race against time to stop the attack.

videos.title: Hospital Ransomware - Part 2
videos.overview: Blackmailer targets ACP Aakash Malik, but a twist emerges: Dr. Sen Gupta sabotaged the hospital generator. The shocking truth is on JioHotstar!

videos.title: Game of Death - Part 1
videos.overview: At a party, Shalini attempts suicide. Strange numbers etched on her skin are the only clues. Can ACP Malik and Ananya uncover the truth behind her desperate act?

videos.title: Game of Death - Part 2
videos.overview: ACP Akash Malik investigates Shalini's disappearance, uncovering a hacker using a game for malicious purposes. His suspicions fall on Ananya Saini. Is she involved?

videos.title: Bank Scam - Part 1
videos.overview: Akash and Ananya investigate a cybercrime where victims lose money after clicking a random link. Ananya finds a key clue, leading them closer to the solution.

videos.title: Bank Scam - Part 2
videos.overview: Akash and Ananya chase a bank scammer to Jharkhand. To trap him, they plan a Hackathon with a big prize. Will their plan work?

videos.title: Fake Video - Part 1
videos.overview: Jyoti Basu's murder video shakes TRACE. Aakash doubts the suspect's guilt, uncovering a connection to a friend's unsolved case. Team loyalty crumbles.

videos.title: Fake Video - Part 2
videos.overview: Deepfake scandal ensnares ex-CM's son. Aakash, Ananya investigate, facing betrayal within their own ranks.
